<p class="page-intro">My policy work translates economic research into choices about energy systems, public finance, and long-run growth. It is grounded in sustained collaboration with governments and researchers rather than one-off commentary.</p>

::: {.policy-principles}
::: {}
<span class="agenda-number">01</span>

### Energy systems

Pricing, contracts, subsidies, metering, utility performance, and the transition to reliable low-carbon power.
:::
::: {}
<span class="agenda-number">02</span>

### Growth strategy

Productivity, exports, cities, structural transformation, and the institutional foundations of investment.
:::
::: {}
<span class="agenda-number">03</span>

### Climate and public finance

Adaptation, critical minerals, fiscal reform, and the distributional consequences of economic transition.
:::
:::

## Selected policy work

::: {.policy-list}
::: {.policy-item}
<span class="policy-year">2026</span>

::: {.policy-item-body}
### [Making Cities Work for Business](https://www.theigc.org/publications/making-cities-work-business)

**IGC policy toolkit · with Victoria Delbridge, Muskan Jain, and Juliana Oliveira-Cunha**<br>
How infrastructure, services, regulation, and labour-market access allow cities to become platforms for firm growth.
:::
:::

::: {.policy-item}
<span class="policy-year">2026</span>

::: {.policy-item-body}
### [Smart Meters for Firms in Ethiopia: Evidence from a Randomised Experiment](https://www.theigc.org/publications/smart-meters-firms-ethiopia-evidence-randomised-experiment)

**IGC policy brief · with Eyoual Tamrat Demeke, Aregawi Gebremariam, Niclas Moneke, Sugandha Srivastav, Ephrem Andargie Tadesse, and Tewodros Assefa Tesemma**<br>
Baseline evidence and policy lessons from an ongoing trial with 1,583 firms and the Ethiopian Electricity Utility.
:::
:::

::: {.policy-item}
<span class="policy-year">2025</span>

::: {.policy-item-body}
### [Climate and Environment: What We Know and What We Need to Know](https://doi.org/10.31389/lsepress.tlc.n)

**Chapter in *The London Consensus* · with Robin Burgess**<br>
An evidence-led agenda for sustainable growth, climate resilience, innovation, and the research still needed by policymakers.
:::
:::

::: {.policy-item}
<span class="policy-year">2025</span>

::: {.policy-item-body}
### [Sustainable Pakistan: Addressing Climate-Driven Demands and Fiscal Challenges for Electricity](https://www.theigc.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Dobermann%20et%20al%20Growth%20brief%20May%202025.pdf)

**IGC growth brief · with Sajid Faiz Malik, Faraz Hayat, and Zuhair Khan**<br>
Why affordability, fiscal sustainability, and renewable energy must be addressed together in Pakistan's power sector.
:::
:::

::: {.policy-item}
<span class="policy-year">2025</span>

::: {.policy-item-body}
### [A Framework for Productivity and Export-Led Growth in Pakistan](https://www.theigc.org/publications/framework-productivity-and-export-led-growth-pakistan)

**Growth framework prepared at the request of Pakistan's Planning Commission · contributing author**<br>
A cross-sector strategy centred on productive jobs, competitiveness, tax and state-owned-enterprise reform, trade, cities, and skills.
:::
:::

::: {.policy-item}
<span class="policy-year">2025</span>

::: {.policy-item-body}
### [Transition-Critical Minerals](https://www.theigc.org/publications/transition-critical-minerals)

**IGC policy note · with Shahrukh Wani and Jonathan Leape**<br>
How mineral-rich countries can build domestic value, diversify supply chains, and manage the environmental costs of extraction.
:::
:::

::: {.policy-item}
<span class="policy-year">2023</span>

::: {.policy-item-body}
### [Innovation, Growth, and the Environment](https://www.theigc.org/news/innovation-growth-and-environment)

**IGC white paper · with Robin Burgess, Stefano Caria, and Allegra Saggese**<br>
A research and policy framework for raising living standards while protecting the natural environment.

## Government engagement

::: {.engagement-grid}
::: {.engagement-card}
<p class="paper-meta">Pakistan</p>

### Energy and fiscal reform

Advice to senior federal decision-makers on electricity tariffs, power-purchase agreements, industrial competitiveness, tax proposals, and macroeconomic reform.
:::

::: {.engagement-card}
<p class="paper-meta">Ethiopia</p>

### National energy policy

Technical review and advice on national energy strategy, electricity reliability, firm performance, and the evidence base for smart-meter deployment.
:::

::: {.engagement-card}
<p class="paper-meta">Myanmar</p>

### Electrification and urban growth

Research and policy support on the National Electrification Plan, energy pricing, infrastructure constraints, and the development of Yangon.
:::
:::
